use_cases: Animated hero section text with particle physics simulation
Interactive landing page headline effect for creative portfolios
Dynamic text reveal animation for marketing campaigns
Visual impact component for SaaS product presentations
Engaging text animation for media and entertainment sites
ai_summary: A Canvas-based particle text effect component featuring physics-driven particle movement with steering behavior, proximity-based velocity control, and smooth color blending transitions. Particles seek text target positions with natural acceleration and deceleration, creating organic flowing animations suitable for hero sections and landing page visual impact.
